ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.8:1 ratio of high-intensity (off-white) to low-intensity (black) pixels visible on the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity (white/cream) elliptical regions occupy the center of the left and right lobes, separated by a dark central column and surrounded by dark trailing and distal margins. Dense, irregular dark mottling is interspersed within the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 3-6 pixels, most pronounced on the distal halves of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal edges terminating in sharp, slightly upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) scattered throughout the central high-intensity regions of both fluke lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Pink/reddish pixel discoloration observed at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
